title: CORS
description: The origins the gateway allows: the cors part of plat5.yml.

allowed_origins.title: allowed_origins
allowed_origins.description: Up to 100. Each is `https://host` or `http://host`, with an optional `:port`. Lowercase, no path, no trailing `/`, no wildcard, no repeats: the gateway compares it byte for byte with the browser's `Origin`.
